doc.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18

title: High Society introductions and bass-drum breaks
summary: They try High Society and its bridge passages and introductions, and Williams says to let the bass drum lay out and hit one beat on the break. The rest of the passage is ASR loops.
